prototype_feel_reasons: The desktop composition has excessive empty space and concentrates all visual content in a narrow central strip.
The sparkle decorations feel slightly arbitrary in placement and scale, particularly the isolated right-side cluster.
The focal illustration is comparatively small for a reveal moment, reducing the screen's sense of payoff.
issues: desktop/focal illustration group — composition feels undersized and top-heavy within the large viewport — modestly enlarge the medallion and rebalance the group vertically
mobile/reveal content — large gap between the medallion and job-title copy weakens visual cohesion — reduce the vertical spacing or group the reveal elements in one responsive container
sparkle decorations — placements feel loosely attached to the focal medallion rather than deliberately framed — anchor them responsively to the medallion with consistent offsets
